sentences.text:
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State, Mr. Rabindra Kumar.
2.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 3 of 2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A,
504, 506, 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It is next submitted that investigation in the case is still going on.

4. The learned APP submits that the offence for which the instant FIR has been instituted, carries punishment of seven years or less, the said submission of the learned APP is not disputed by learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.34936 of 2024(2) dt.14-05-2024 petitioner.

5. In view of the submission made by the learned APP, the anticipatory bail application is disposed of in terms of the order dated 13-2-2024 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari vs. the State of Bihar).
